title: An erase of an already-empty record may never be announced (Fable, fix 4 PR 2a review Q1)
evidence: Not a bug (Fable, PR 2a round 3): visibleContentOf strips meta but keeps eraseOf(file) in what it compares (packages/health-core/src/record-session.ts:71-72), so an erase of an empty record still changes what adopt (record-session.ts:609) sees, and the page hears it
